question: Why is the frozen C1/C1.5 MARKET_BEHAVIOR state sequence dominated by 1-bar duration (churn 0.6473 at M15)? Attribute the cause rather than assume it.

hypotheses.A_ONTOLOGY_CONFLICT: The behaviour label is assigned by a priority chain over sub-engines; conflicting sub-labels force the top-level label to flip between rules. Test: decompose assignment source frequency and count bars where sub-engines disagree.
hypotheses.B_GRANULARITY: The label set is finer than the timescale; duration measured in hours is stable while duration in bars is 1. Test: compare bar-duration and hour-duration across M5/M15/H1 and label entropy.
hypotheses.C_BAR_BOUNDARY_ALIASING: Churn is concentrated at session/day/weekend boundaries where the bar clock resets level/ATR state. Test: state-change rate at boundaries vs interior.
hypotheses.D_MEASUREMENT_NOISE: Threshold coincidences: many bars sit on rule thresholds so tiny measurement noise flips labels. Test: inject sub-threshold noise (0.01*ATR) at multiple seeds, measure label agreement.
hypotheses.E_GENUINE_MARKET_CHURN: The market itself genuinely changes state every ~15 min at this timescale. Test: compare observed duration/churn against an IID-return surrogate and a block-bootstrap (block=48) surrogate built from the SAME returns with the SAME labeler.
hypotheses.F_NO_HYSTERESIS: The frozen rules have no minimum-duration/persistence requirement, so single-bar excursions are recorded as full transitions. Test: apply a diagnostic carry-forward hysteresis (k=2,3,5) to the SAME frozen labels and measure duration inflation.
hypotheses.G_UNKNOWN_LEAKAGE: NO_DEFINED_STATE / UNKNOWN_REASON bars are emitted as their own label, inflating apparent transitions. Test: count UNKNOWN/NO_DEFINED bars and measure churn if they carry forward the previous defined state (diagnostic only).
hypotheses.H_INSTRUMENT_SCALE: Our re-implementation misapplies the frozen rules (scale/window error). Test: reproduce the published C1.5 metrics on the identical inputs; mismatch => instrument fault, fix instrument before attributing cause.

decision_rules.instrument_gate: if hypothesis H fails (reproduction off by >0.001 absolute on persistence or churn), STOP attribution; fix instrument first
decision_rules.attribution_rule: a hypothesis is SUPPORTED only if its test metric separates from the null by the pre-registered margin (churn delta >= 0.05 absolute OR duration-median delta >= 1.0 bar) AND the effect is stable across >= 2 timeframes or >= 2 seeds
decision_rules.no_tuning: no threshold in the frozen ontology may be changed; every perturbation is diagnostic and reported as a delta, never adopted

forbidden: editing C1/C1.5 or Phase B artifacts
